chunk_1.page_content:
Interface Requirements Specification

Four Packet Formats for Name-Boundary Detection

Document ID: IRS-SAMPLE-007    |    Version: 1.0    |    Status: Draft

chunk_3.page_content:
## 1.1 Purpose

This document defines ten illustrative application-level packet formats that carry the same personal identification information. The formats differ in how the Name field is bounded: fixed size, length prefix, termination character, or packet header and footer.

chunk_4.page_content:
## 1.2 Scope

Each packet contains a Name, Age, and Roll Number. The Age and Roll Number fields retain the definitions from the source sample specification.

chunk_5.page_content:
## 1.3 Original Packet Structure

The original packet uses a 6-byte ASCII Header HEADER, a 20-byte ASCII Name padded with NULL bytes, a 1-byte Age, a 1-byte Roll Number, and a 6-byte ASCII Footer FOOTER. Its total size is 34 bytes. Packet 3.1 preserves this structure.

chunk_7.page_content:
## 2.1 Field Order and Byte Numbering

Fields are serialized in the order shown in each Field Layout table. Offsets are zero-based from the first byte of the packet. All sizes are measured in bytes.

chunk_8.page_content:
## 2.2 Character Encoding

Header, Name, Footer, and Name terminator fields use ASCII. Name lengths are measured in encoded bytes. Names shall contain printable ASCII characters except where a packet definition specifies padding.

chunk_9.page_content:
## 2.3 Age and Roll Number

Age occupies exactly 1 byte and is represented as an unsigned 8-bit integer with valid range 0–255. Roll Number occupies exactly 1 byte and is represented as an unsigned 8-bit integer with valid range 0–255. These definitions apply unchanged to all four packets.

chunk_10.page_content:
## 2.4 Common Marker Values

Where present, Header shall contain the six ASCII bytes HEADER. Where present, Footer shall contain the six ASCII bytes FOOTER.

chunk_11.page_content:
# 3. PACKET DEFINITIONS

All Packets are travelling from “Subsystem A” to “Subsystem B”.

chunk_13.page_content:
### 3.1.1 Packet Overview

This packet preserves the original fixed-length structure. Name always occupies exactly 10 bytes. Short names are padded with NULL bytes.

chunk_14.page_content:
### 3.1.2 Field Layout
Field Size (bytes) Type / Encoding Requirements
Header 7 ASCII Exact value: HEADER1
Name 10 ASCII Exactly 10 bytes. Unused bytes shall be padded with 0x00. Names longer than 10 bytes shall be rejected by default.
Age 1 Unsigned 8-bit integer Valid range: 0–255.
Roll Number 1 Unsigned 8-bit integer Valid range: 0–255.
Footer 7 ASCII Exact value: FOOTER1

chunk_15.page_content:
### 3.1.3 Length and Validation

Expected total size: Exactly 26 bytes.

The packet shall be exactly 26 bytes.

Bytes 0–6 shall contain HEADER1.

Bytes 7–16 shall contain the 10-byte Name field, including NULL padding where required.

Byte 17 shall contain Age and byte 18 shall contain Roll Number.

Bytes 19–25 shall contain FOOTER1.

Age and Roll Number shall each be interpreted as unsigned 8-bit values.

chunk_17.page_content:
### 3.2.1 Packet Overview

This packet carries a variable-length Name preceded by a one-byte Name Length field. Name Length specifies the exact number of ASCII bytes in Name.

chunk_18.page_content:
### 3.2.2 Field Layout
Field Size (bytes) Type / Encoding Requirements
Header 7 ASCII Exact value: HEADER2.
Name Length 1 Unsigned 8-bit integer Number of encoded bytes in Name; valid range 1–64. Does not include this prefix.
Name Name Length ASCII Variable length. Its byte length shall equal Name Length. NULL padding is not used.
Age 1 Unsigned 8-bit integer Valid range: 0–255.
Roll Number 1 Unsigned 8-bit integer Valid range: 0–255.
Footer 7 ASCII Exact value: FOOTER2.

chunk_19.page_content:
### 3.2.3 Length and Validation

Expected total size: Variable: 17 + Name Length bytes.

The packet shall begin with HEADER2 and end with FOOTER2.

Name Length shall be between 1 and 64, in little endian.

The receiver shall read exactly Name Length bytes for Name.

Age and Roll Number shall each occupy exactly one byte and be interpreted as unsigned 8-bit values.

Total packet length shall equal 15 + Name Length bytes.

Truncated packets and trailing bytes shall be rejected.

chunk_21.page_content:
### 3.3.1 Packet Overview

This packet carries a variable-length Name preceded by a one-byte Name Length field. Name Length specifies the exact number of ASCII bytes in Name.

chunk_22.page_content:
### 3.3.2 Field Layout
Field Size (bytes) Type / Encoding Requirements
Header 7 ASCII Exact value: HEADER3.
Name Length 1 Unsigned 8-bit integer Number of encoded bytes in Name; valid range 1–64. Including this prefix.
Name Name Length ASCII Variable length. Its byte length shall equal Name Length. NULL padding is not used.
Age 1 Unsigned 8-bit integer Valid range: 0–255.
Roll Number 1 Unsigned 8-bit integer Valid range: 0–255.
Footer 7 ASCII Exact value: FOOTER3.

chunk_23.page_content:
### 3.3.3 Length and Validation

Expected total size: Variable: 17 + Name Length bytes.

The packet shall begin with HEADER3 and end with FOOTER3.

Name Length shall be between 1 and 64, in little endian.

The receiver shall read exactly Name Length bytes for Name.

Age and Roll Number shall each occupy exactly one byte and be interpreted as unsigned 8-bit values.

Total packet length shall equal 17 + Name Length bytes.

Truncated packets and trailing bytes shall be rejected.

chunk_25.page_content:
### 3.4.1 Packet Overview

This packet carries a variable-length Name terminated by the ASCII vertical bar character '|'. The terminator is a separate field and is not part of Name.

chunk_26.page_content:
### 3.4.2 Field Layout
Field Size (bytes) Type / Encoding Requirements
Header 7 ASCII Exact value: HEADER4.
Age 1 Unsigned 8-bit integer Valid range: 0–255.
Name Variable ASCII Ends at the first occurrence of terminator byte 0x5C7C. Valid length: 1–64 bytes.
Name Terminator 2 ASCII Exact value: '\|' (0x5C7C). Not included in Name.
Roll Number 1 Unsigned 8-bit integer Valid range: 0–255.
Footer 7 ASCII Exact value: FOOTER4.

chunk_27.page_content:
### 3.4.3 Length and Validation

Expected total size: Variable: 18 + Name length bytes.

The packet shall begin with HEADER4 and end with FOOTER4.

The receiver shall locate the first 0x5C7C byte after Header to determine the end of Name.

Name shall contain 1–64 ASCII bytes and shall not contain an unescaped vertical bar.

The 0x5C7C terminator shall immediately follow Name and is not part of Name.

Age and Roll Number shall each occupy exactly one byte and be interpreted as unsigned 8-bit values.

The packet shall be rejected if the terminator is missing or the resulting layout is incomplete.

chunk_29.page_content:
### 3.5.1 Packet Overview

This packet uses Header and Footer to identify the beginning and end of the complete packet. Name has no separate length prefix and no termination character. Its length is derived from the packet boundary after accounting for the fixed Age and Roll Number fields.

chunk_30.page_content:
### 3.5.2 Field Layout
Field Size (bytes) Type / Encoding Requirements
Header 7 ASCII Exact value: HEADER5. Marks the beginning of the packet.
Age 1 Unsigned 8-bit integer Valid range: 0–255. Located immediately before Roll Number and Footer.
Roll Number 1 Unsigned 8-bit integer Valid range: 0–255. Located immediately before Footer.
Name Variable ASCII Occupies the variable-length region after Header and before the fixed trailing fields. Valid length: 1–64 bytes.
Footer 7 ASCII Exact value: FOOTER5. Marks the end of the packet.

chunk_31.page_content:
### 3.5.3 Length and Validation

Expected total size: Variable: 16 + Name length bytes.

The receiver shall locate HEADER5 to identify the beginning of a candidate packet.

The receiver shall locate FOOTER5 to identify the end of the candidate packet.

Age and Roll Number are the two bytes immediately preceding FOOTER5.

Name consists of all bytes between Header and Age.

Name shall contain 1–64 ASCII bytes and shall not contain the complete FOOTER marker sequence.

Total packet length shall equal 16 + Name length bytes.

The packet shall be rejected if either marker is missing, markers are out of order, or derived Name length is outside the permitted range.

chunk_33.page_content:
### 3.6.1 Packet Overview

This packet carries two variable-lengthed fields: Name and City, preceded by a one-byte prefix field each. Name Length specifies the exact number of ASCII bytes in Name. City Length Specifies the exact number of ASCII bytes in the City.

chunk_34.page_content:
### 3.6.2 Field Layout
Field Size (bytes) Type / Encoding Requirements
Header 7 ASCII Exact value: HEADER6.
Age 1 Unsigned 8-bit integer Valid range: 0–255.
Name Length 1 Unsigned 8-bit integer Number of encoded bytes in Name; valid range 1–64. Does not include this prefix.
Name Name Length ASCII Variable length. Its byte length shall equal Name Length. NULL padding is not used.
Preposition 4 ASCII Fixed value: “from”
City Length 1 Unsigned 8-bit integer Number of encoded bytes in City; valid range 1–64. Does not include this prefix.
City City length ASCII Variable length. Its byte length shall equal City Length. NULL padding is not used.
Roll Number 1 Unsigned 8-bit integer Valid range: 0–255.
Footer 7 ASCII Exact value: FOOTER2.

chunk_35.page_content:
### 3.6.3 Length and Validation

Expected total size: Variable: 22 + Name Length + City Length bytes.

The packet shall begin with HEADER6 and end with FOOTER6.

Name Length shall be between 1 and 64, in little endian.

The receiver shall read exactly Name Length bytes for Name.

The receiver shall read exactly City Length bytes for City.

Age and Roll Number shall each occupy exactly one byte and be interpreted as unsigned 8-bit values.

Total packet length shall equal 22 + Name Length + City Length bytes.

Truncated packets and trailing bytes shall be rejected.

chunk_37.page_content:
### 3.7.1 Packet Overview

This packet carries two variable-lengthed fields: Name and City, preceded by a one-byte prefix field each. Name Length specifies the exact number of ASCII bytes in Name. City Length Specifies the exact number of ASCII bytes in the City.

chunk_38.page_content:
### 3.7.2 Field Layout
Field Size (bytes) Type / Encoding Requirements
Header 7 ASCII Exact value: HEADER7.
Age 1 Unsigned 8-bit integer Valid range: 0–255.
Name Length 1 Unsigned 8-bit integer Number of encoded bytes in Name; valid range 1–64. Does not include this prefix.
Name Name Length ASCII Variable length. Its byte length shall equal Name Length. NULL padding is not used.
Preposition 4 ASCII Fixed value: “from”
City Length 1 Unsigned 8-bit integer Number of encoded bytes in City; valid range 1–64. Includes this Prefix.
City City length ASCII Variable length. Its byte length shall equal City Length. NULL padding is not used.
Roll Number 1 Unsigned 8-bit integer Valid range: 0–255.
Footer 7 ASCII Exact value: FOOTER7.

chunk_39.page_content:
### 3.7.3 Length and Validation

Expected total size: Variable: 22 + Name Length + City Length Prefix + City Length bytes.

The packet shall begin with HEADER7 and end with FOOTER7.

Name Length shall be between 1 and 64, in little endian.

The receiver shall read exactly Name Length bytes for Name.

The receiver shall read exactly City Length bytes minus City Length Prefix bytes for City.

Age and Roll Number shall each occupy exactly one byte and be interpreted as unsigned 8-bit values.

Total packet length shall equal 22 + Name Length + City Length Prefix + City Length bytes.

Truncated packets and trailing bytes shall be rejected.

chunk_41.page_content:
### 3.8.1 Packet Overview

This packet carries two variable-lengthed fields: Name and City. Name Length specifies the exact number of ASCII bytes in Name. City is determined by a Delimiter.

chunk_42.page_content:
### 3.8.2 Field Layout
Field Size (bytes) Type / Encoding Requirements
Header 7 ASCII Exact value: HEADER8.
Roll Number 1 Unsigned 8-bit integer Valid range: 0–255.
Name Length 1 Unsigned 8-bit integer Number of encoded bytes in Name; valid range 1–64. Does not include this prefix.
Name Name Length ASCII Variable length. Its byte length shall equal Name Length. NULL padding is not used.
Preposition 4 ASCII Fixed value: “from”
City City length ASCII Variable length. Its byte length shall equal City Length. NULL padding is not used.
City Delimiter 1 ASCII The symbol “|” whose ascii value is 0x7C
Age 1 Unsigned 8-bit integer Valid range: 0–255.
Footer 7 ASCII Exact value: FOOTER8.

chunk_43.page_content:
### 3.8.3 Length and Validation

Expected total size: Variable: 22 + Name Length + City Length bytes.

The packet shall begin with HEADER8 and end with FOOTER8.

Name Length shall be between 1 and 64, in little endian.

The receiver shall read exactly Name Length bytes for Name.

The receiver shall read City until it encounters the first delimiter “|” with the value “0x7C”.

Age and Roll Number shall each occupy exactly one byte and be interpreted as unsigned 8-bit values.

Total packet length shall equal 22 + Name Length+ City length bytes.

Truncated packets and trailing bytes shall be rejected.

chunk_45.page_content:
### 3.9.1 Packet Overview

This packet carries two variable-lengthed fields: Name and Description. Name is determined by a Delimiter. Description is determined by consuming all the remaining bytes in the field.

chunk_46.page_content:
### 3.9.2 Field Layout
Field Size (bytes) Type / Encoding Requirements
Header 7 ASCII Exact value: HEADER9.
Roll Number 1 Unsigned 8-bit integer Valid range: 0–255.
Name Variable ASCII Ends at the first occurrence of terminator byte 0x5C. Valid length: 1–64 bytes.
Name Terminator 1 ASCII Exact value: '\' (0x5C). Not included in Name.
Age 1 Unsigned 8-bit integer Valid range: 0–255.
Description Variable ASCII Occupies the variable-length region after Header and before the fixed trailing fields. Valid length: 1–64 bytes.
Footer 7 ASCII Exact value: FOOTER9.

chunk_47.page_content:
### 3.9.3 Length and Validation

Expected total size: Variable: 17 + Name Length + Description Length bytes.

The packet shall begin with HEADER9 and end with FOOTER9.

The receiver shall read Name until it encounters the first delimiter “|” with the value “0x7C”.

Age and Roll Number shall each occupy exactly one byte and be interpreted as unsigned 8-bit values.

The Description shall consume as many bytes as available to it until the next field is observed

Total packet length shall equal 17 + Name Length+ Description length bytes.

Truncated packets and trailing bytes shall be rejected.

chunk_49.page_content:
### 3.10.1 Packet Overview

This packet carries two variable-lengthed fields: Name and Description. Name is determined by a Delimiter. Description is determined by consuming all the remaining bytes in the field.

chunk_50.page_content:
### 3.10.2 Field Layout
Field Size (bytes) Type / Encoding Requirements
Header 7 ASCII Exact value: HEADERA.
Roll Number 1 Unsigned 8-bit integer Valid range: 0–255.
Name Variable ASCII Ends at the first occurrence of terminator byte 0x247C. Valid length: 1–64 bytes.
Name Terminator 2 ASCII Exact value: '$|' (0x247C). Not included in Name.
Age 1 Unsigned 8-bit integer Valid range: 0–255.
Description Variable ASCII Ends at the first occurrence of terminator byte 0x5C. Valid length: 1–64 bytes.
Name Terminator 1 ASCII Exact value: '\’ (0x5C). Not included in Description.
Footer 7 ASCII Exact value: FOOTERA.

chunk_51.page_content:
### 3.10.3 Length and Validation

Expected total size: Variable: 19 + Name Length + Description Length bytes.

The packet shall begin with HEADERA and end with FOOTERA.

The receiver shall read Name until it encounters the first delimiter “$|” with the value “0x247C”.

The receiver shall read Name until it encounters the first delimiter “\” with the value “0x5C”.

Age and Roll Number shall each occupy exactly one byte and be interpreted as unsigned 8-bit values.

Total packet length shall equal 19 + Name Length+ Description length bytes.

Truncated packets and trailing bytes shall be rejected.

chunk_52.page_content:
# 4. CROSS-PACKET INTERFACE SUMMARY
Packet Name Name Boundary Mechanism Name Size Packet Size
Fixed Identity Packet Fixed field size Exactly 20 bytes 34 bytes
Length-Prefixed Identity Packet One-byte length prefix 1–64 bytes 15 + Name Length
Delimited Identity Packet ASCII '|' terminator 1–64 bytes 15 + Name Length
Header-Footer Bounded Identity Packet Packet Header and Footer 1–64 bytes 14 + Name Length

chunk_54.page_content:
## 5.1 Fixed-Length Packet

The Fixed Identity Packet shall be validated against its exact 34-byte size and fixed field offsets.

chunk_55.page_content:
## 5.2 Variable-Length Packets

The Length-Prefixed Identity Packet derives Name length from Name Length. The Delimited Identity Packet derives Name length from the 0x5C terminator. The Header-Footer Bounded Identity Packet derives Name length from the complete packet boundary and the fixed trailing Age and Roll Number fields.

chunk_56.page_content:
## 5.3 Common Numeric Field Validation

For all four packet types, Age and Roll Number shall each be exactly one byte and shall be interpreted as unsigned 8-bit integers with valid values from 0 through 255.

chunk_57.page_content:
# 6. DOCUMENT NOTES

The first packet retains the original sample packet's field sizes, marker values, field order, and Age/Roll Number definitions. The remaining three packets change the mechanism used to determine the Name field boundary. Each packet has at most one Header field; no packet uses duplicate or nested headers.

Original demonstration values: Name = HAARD SHAH; Age = 22; Roll Number = 15.
